gate: Every native carrier RGBA Float32 word must equal the built browser word. No output tolerance, branch epsilon, state quantization or node-output repair.
body: Static typed count0..64;1..4 FLOAT/VECTOR states. Each update copies its own state or adds/subtracts one bounded sixteenth-grid constant within+/-16 or a converted native integer Iteration0..63. Positive-count seeds are bounded sixteenth-grid literals within+/-16 only (including assembled literal vector components). UV fields, including authored clamp[0,1] then SNAP.25 fields, refuse until a checked phase-margin producer contract exists. Zero counts preserve the selected upstream expression under its existing qualification. No rewrite or fidelity credit for the official Mandelbrot demo.
derivation: All state values remain multiples of1/16. Constant-step magnitude is<=16+64*16=1040. Counter-step magnitude is<=16+sum(0..63)=2032. Thus every intermediate is within[-2048,2048] and exactly representable in normal Float32 or zero. Each own-state addition/subtraction is exact. There is no multiplication recurrence, implicit reduction or nonlinear branch inside the admitted loop.
carrier: An independent reversible encoder OUTSIDE the loop maps a selected scalar v to n=(v+2048)*16, high=floor(n/256), low=n-high*256, RGB=(high/256,low/256,0), alpha1. For admitted states n is an integer0..65536, high0..256, low0..255. These dyadic byte fractions survive native emission/HDR storage. Decode v=(R*65536+G*256-32768)/16. The carrier is separately authored and pinned in both native and browser IR; it does not repair or change the ported operator.
nativeBoundaries: Raw negative emission clamps and raw high-HDR output can lose node words. Native direct cross-state aliases may follow sequential end-item assignments; these are quarantined. Native animation/drivers, including Mandelbrot's actual frame driver, remain refused until transport shares the real playback/seek/pause timeline. All positive-count UV field seeds are refused, including quantized/clamped authoring shapes.
cost: No expression-tree unroll. A real shader Loop is required; generated shader inspection must see exactly1 loop per admitted output,0 for count0. Repeated serialized loop uses are cached per channel. Limits:64 iterations,4 states,256 serialized body nodes,8192 weighted operations and8 unique loops per channel; source emission2048 visits/depth64 and group depth16. Deferred IR owns an immutable clone and checks cancellation. No loop-owned GPU resources.
unqualifiedFields: Retained scalar/vector/group clamp+SNAP field fixtures are research/refusal controls only. A1ULP input difference between0.2499999850988388 and0.25 changes SNAP.25 from0 to0.25. Positive fixture raster-center margins cannot justify arbitrary authored UV interpolation. No tolerance was widened.
